topic: You are allowed to start again

slides.eyebrow: LIFE LESSONS FOR A BETTER YOU
slides.body: Kabhi-kabhi new beginning hi woh chance hota hai jiska tum wait kar rahe the.
slides.note: A fresh start is still progress.

slides.body: Ek mistake, ek rejection ya ek bad phase tumhari poori story define nahi karta.
slides.note: You are more than one chapter.

slides.body: Jo seekh tum pehle miss kar gaye, wahi restart ko smarter bana sakti hai.
Bas ek honest next step lo. Momentum action se wapas aata hai.
Ek habit, ek project ya ek conversation choose karo aur uska first step aaj lo.
Tumhe permission kisi aur se nahi chahiye. Aaj se apni story ka next page likho.

caption:
Restart karna haar maan-na nahi hota. Kabhi-kabhi wahi sabse brave decision hota hai.

Aaj ek cheez choose karo jise tum dobara start karna chahte ho—and take the first small step.
